text:
Alex Chen: Morning — need to lock a 60m design review for the API + SDK + Console UX changes for the multi-model routing feature. Prefer next week (Wed or Thu). Goal: agree API contract, SDK ergonomics, Console flows, and rollout/fallbacks. Who can present which section?

Maya Patel: Wed works for me (afternoon PT). Can we aim for 11:30am PT?

Jordan G: Thu morning PT is better on my side. If we do Wed I might be tight for the SDK deep-dive.

Alex Chen: Ok noted. Plan: Maya presents API surface, Jordan does SDK migration notes, Lina owns Console screens. Samir — can infra join a short pre-brief to confirm rollout constraints?

Samir Kapoor: Yep — I can do a 30m pre-brief Tue 10:00am PT. Blocked that slot now.

Maya Patel: I'll prepare the pre-read with links + short list of open questions. Expect a doc by EOD Monday. Link will be in this thread once ready.

Alex Chen: Pre-read checklist (paste into the doc please):
```
- one-page summary + decision ask
- endpoints and example payloads
- migration and compatibility notes
- performance/latency expectations and SLOs
- rollout/fallback plan with canary thresholds
- basic QA/eval checklist and smoke prompts
```

Lina Torres: For Console I'll attach mockups and a 3-step interaction gif. ETA Mon morning.

Jordan G: SDK will include code snippets and a minimal upgrade guide. Can someone add a quick compatibility matrix (versions + breaking changes)?

Maya Patel: @Samir Kapoor can you confirm infra will attend the Tue pre-brief? Also, do we want product in the design review or just a short sync?

Samir Kapoor: Confirmed — infra pre-brief Tue 10:00am PT. Product should join the main review for rollout decisions; please ping Product PMs in the doc.

CI-bot: Calendar invite created by Alex Chen for Wed 11:30am PT (60m). Alternative slot Thu 09:00am PT added as tentative. Poll: https://polls.internal/meet/zzh123

Alex Chen: Thanks — if no major conflicts by EOD Tuesday, we'll lock Wed 11:30am PT. If you have hard constraints reply here. Otherwise add pre-read links and tag presenters. :thumbsup:
